title: Strengthen the Chapter 1 analysis of fragmentation and its costs
requirements:
- Bring the structural-incentives analysis forward as framing
- Qualify the quadratic-cost claim as the worst case for point-to-point integration
- Distinguish programme-vertical fragmentation from organisation/market-driven fragmentation so high-income readers see their case
- Add guidance on coalitions, accountability and the first-mover cost problem for early connecting programmes
- Add a figure contrasting point-to-point and shared-capability connection
- Consider quantifying fragmentation with country evidence
